question: Which women are excluded when a śūdra may take partners from all classes?
premises: Brāhmaṇa, kṣatriya, and vaiśya women are mentioned.
They are to be abandoned or excluded.
The context allows partners from all classes otherwise.
inference: Even when taking partners from all classes, a śūdra must exclude women of the three higher classes.
plain_english: But having excluded brāhmaṇa, kṣatriya, and vaiśya women, among all other classes—
